dedupe_keys.name: koreageotechdb curated geotechnical database from over 220 000 boring logs south korea

description: KoreaGeoTechDB is a national database of borehole data for South Korea: soil layer stratigraphy, Standard Penetration Test blow counts, shear-wave velocity profiles, bedrock depth and averaged soil parameters, with geological and topographic attributes for each site. It was compiled by Hanyang University with Kangwon National University, the Korea Meteorological Administration and the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology from 295,851 boring logs, of which 224,965 passed quality control. Coverage is national at borehole points. Access: version 1.0 published on Zenodo on 2 June 2026 as CSV tables (sites, projects, layers, SPT, shear-wave velocity) and a 534 MB SQL dump; an associated journal article describes it. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: borehole density follows where construction took place, and derived averages depend on the QC rules applied. Simulation uses: site classification and VS30 mapping for seismic ground-motion and building damage models, and foundation hazard screening for buildings and critical facilities. Related records: building seismic fragility datasets and national building inventories used with it in loss models.
